periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop shape with a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward elongation with the lowest point extending toward the snout, well below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curvature on the posterior edge, transitioning into a wide transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band covering the majority of the upper shoulder region, maintaining uniform width across the visible dorsal midline.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the top of both visible ears.
